messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Dedicated pool eu-west-2/pool-07 p99 latency > 10s for 3 consecutive 1m windows. Autoscaler reported delayed hotshot warmup. Thread started 1748888000

sara_oncall: I'm on it — paging infra and ops. Observed client-facing p99 spike, some streaming stalls reported.

ev an_infra: typo in name fixed -> evan_infra: digging into autoscaler logs now. Initial read: scale decisions queued, warmup tasks backlog grew.

nina_ml: seeing many requests hitting the cold-kv path and long kv miss times (~120ms per kv fetch) which amplifies tail. Might be cache eviction churn.

sara_oncall: customer impact? amy_support?
amy_support: Support notes: 3 customers reported timeouts from chat streaming. One enterprise (acct E-473) reported degraded responses; they hit p95 ~ 6s, p99 ~ 12s. They're seeing partial streaming (first chunk, then stall).

lee_ops: rolling through telemetry: queue depth on pool-07 spiked from 40->420 in 30s. Autoscaler launched 4 hotshot nodes but warmup handshake stuck in REGISTERED -> READY for ~90s each.

ev an_infra: here's snippet from autoscaler controller logs:
```
2026-03-15T09:13:21Z controller: enqueue scaleup request pool-07 target=+4 reason=queue_depth
2026-03-15T09:13:23Z provisioner: provision request accepted id=hotshot-907
2026-03-15T09:14:12Z hotshot-907: pulling model artifacts
2026-03-15T09:15:05Z warmup: kv-load start
2026-03-15T09:16:48Z hotshot-907: failed handshake -> timeout waiting for heartbeat
```
Looks like the handshake timeout param hit at ~90s.

sara_oncall: is this a widespread handshake regression or per-pool?

ev an_infra: initial evidence suggests a spike in artifact download latency from model-registry CDN edge in eu-west-2 at 09:14:00. Pulls delayed, causing warmup to overlap and then hit heartbeat timeouts.

nina_ml: plus model KV cache misses causing long warmup KV-fill. Combined effect = longer than expected coldstart.

raj_oncall: I'm taking over page (oncall rotation). Sara handing off. Summary: p99 spike due to pool saturation and autoscaler warmup delay; customer-visible streaming stalls.

sara_oncall: handing to raj_oncall — main asks: (1) stop new traffic to pool-07; (2) attempt emergency scale to other pools/regions; (3) notify affected customers.

amy_support: notified E-473 and they acknowledged. Created incident ticket INC-2026-472. They're asking for ETA.

raj_oncall: immediate mitigations — ops, can we drain pool-07 from routing?

lee_ops: yes. I'll apply route weight 0 for pool-07 on the router layer for non-reserved traffic. Runbook command: `routectl adjust pool-07 --weight 0 --reason "hotshot warmup lag"`

ev an_infra: I'll try to accelerate warmup: bump handshake timeout to 180s for pending hotshot nodes to avoid abort during artifact blips. Patch command: `kubectl patch cm autoscaler-config -p '{"data":{"handshake_timeout_secs":"180"}}'` then restart controller.

nina_ml: recommend fallback model variant with smaller artifacts (quantized) for streaming endpoints — can cut model pull size by ~40%. If routing supports variant fallback, we should enable it to reduce new node pulls.

lee_ops: deploying route change now. Expect ~30s to propagate.

incidents-bot: :white_check_mark: route change applied: pool-07 weight -> 0. New routing in effect 1748888090.

raj_oncall: good. Next — scale up capacity in eu-west-1 as overflow. lee_ops can you open burst capacity in eu-west-1 and create a temporary mapping for non-reserved tenants?

lee_ops: provisioning eu-west-1 hotshot group. Provisioning command: `provisioner create --region eu-west-1 --type hotshot --count 6 --tags temp-overflow`

ev an_infra: I'm patching autoscaler to accept in-flight warmup extension and to pin nodes to pre-pulled artifacts if available. Also kicking off a manual artifact pre-pull for the quantized variant to eu-west-1.

nina_ml: executing pre-pull script to eu-west-1 nodes:
```
for host in $(list-new-nodes); do ssh $host "curl -fSLO https://models.cdn/redwood/ggml-small-q8.bin" &
done
wait
```
This should finish in ~45-60s depending on infra.

amy_support: E-473 asked for estimated recovery. I told them ~5-10min pending route propagation + eu-west-1 warmup. They requested priority updates.

raj_oncall: posting status to status.redwood.ai: "Partial degradation in eu-west-2: streaming stalls and elevated latency. Mitigation in progress: draining affected pool, routing to eu-west-1 overflow. ETA 10 min."

incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Post to status page succeeded.

lee_ops: eu-west-1 hotshots are coming up. Pre-pull success logs: `artifact fetch OK` on 4/6 nodes so far.

ev an_infra: increased handshake timeout applied. Restarted autoscaler controller (rolling restart). Watching for nodes to transition READY.

nina_ml: monitoring client telemetry — p95 dropping from 6s -> 1.2s for traffic that got routed to eu-west-1; p99 still elevated for remaining connections hitting pool-07.

raj_oncall: is there customer-visible fallback we can enable for streaming to reduce message chunk size (less kv pulls)?

nina_ml: yes — switch streaming config to `small_chunk=true` for affected routes. Command: `redwood-config set /routes/chat/streaming chunk_size=512` (was 2048). That reduces per-chunk KV load.

lee_ops: applied small_chunk flag for non-reserved routes.

incidents-bot: :white_check_mark: small_chunk applied 1748888224.

amy_support: E-473 confirms partial improvement. They still see occasional stalls but frequency reduced.

ev an_infra: autoscaler logs now show hotshot nodes reaching READY: hotshot-907 READY at 1748888241, hotshot-908 READY at 1748888255. Handshake extension avoided aborts.

raj_oncall: routing back? Not yet — want stable metrics for 2 minutes. Current metrics: queue depth pool-07 down from 420 -> 28, p99 cluster-wide down from 12s -> 2.1s.

incidents-bot: :information_source: Post-mitigation summary to channel in 10m.

lee_ops: routing back: I'll gradually return weight but keep small_chunk enabled for 10m. `routectl adjust pool-07 --weight 30`

sara_oncall: thanks all. Follow-ups: (1) investigate CDN artifact latency spike with platform infra (ticket INFRA-2026-881); (2) add autoscaler resilience: fallback to quantized variant automatically if warmup pending > 45s; (3) consider proactive artifact pre-pull for high-traffic pools during promotions.

nina_ml: I'll open ML action item to add variant-fallback logic and a small end-to-end test for warmup path.

ev an_infra: logging ticket and will attach controller traces. I want to add circuit breaker so controller doesn't abort on short CDN blips.

raj_oncall: final incident status: Mitigated. Customer impact: streaming stalls for select enterprise customers E-473/E-991 for ~12-18 minutes. Root causes: artifact CDN latency + KV cache coldpath amplified warmup time -> autoscaler handshake timeouts. Next steps noted. I'll paste runbook blameless postmortem link when created.

incidents-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident marked MITIGATED at 1748888365.

amy_support: will follow up with affected customers with timeline and RCA when ready.

lee_ops: leaving a short note in the runbook: `mitigations used: route drain, overflow to eu-west-1, handshake timeout bump, small_chunk flag, manual pre-pull`

sara_oncall: thanks team — handoff complete. Raj you own postmortem.

raj_oncall: acknowledged. Closing channel for now.
